ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.

2. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

3. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.

4. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. going

5. When practising Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.

6. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. happiness

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

8. When practising Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening.

9. When practising Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

10. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

11. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

12. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
